mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id FROM organization_sync_source WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM organization_sync_batch WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
SELECT id FROM organization_sync_batch WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT tenant_id,id,trace_id FROM organization_sync_batch WHERE status='QUEUED' OR (status='FETCHING' AND lease_until<=#{leaseUntil}) ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT #{SCAN_LIMIT}
SELECT id FROM organization_sync_batch WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND pending_tenant_id=#{pendingTenantId}
SELECT batch_version,status,state_json FROM organization_sync_transition WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND batch_id=#{id} AND batch_version<=#{version} ORDER BY batch_version

SELECT id,source_key,after_revision,received_revision,status,version,requested_by,created_at FROM organization_sync_batch WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM organization_sync_batch WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant}
SELECT external_id FROM organization_sync_binding WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND kind=#{kind} AND local_id=#{id}
